prompt:
Local sprite-face redesign on this exact character. Her FACE is the only part the player dislikes, so do not copy its current facial construction again. Please make a CLEAR facial change, not a nearly identical touch-up. Preserve the exact rest of this pixel sprite (all hair silhouette, bow, costume, body, limbs, boots, standing pose and placement). Only exposed skin of face and facial features may change. Full-body 1254x1254 transparent PNG output, same padded layout.

Replace the current square jaw and huge black-and-white anime eyes with an appealing softly oval face and SMALLER, gentler warm brown eyes. Narrow the lower jaw by roughly 12%, shorten the face below the nose slightly, round cheek-to-chin transitions using clean pixel steps. No long straight horizontal chin. Eyes about 15% smaller than now: warm brown iris/pupil clusters dominate, with ONLY a tiny ivory glint at the upper side; remove the broad stark white outer eye columns that turn into goggles at game size. Thin warm-brown eyelids, no giant black triangles, soft small relaxed eyebrows above. A balanced calm gaze turned slightly left in 3/4 perspective. Tiny softly indicated nose, warm gentle closed smile, restrained cheek blush. Make her look like a naturally pretty young adult adventurer from a warm, cozy 16-bit pixel farming game, not an anime doll or a blocky chibi.

Facial PIXEL clusters should be SIMPLE and deliberately arranged for a body only 83 pixels tall at gameplay size: dark eye marks and one ivory eye glint each, separated friendly smile made of a small solid terracotta cluster. No white bands or noisy detail, no harsh angular jaw, no pointed chin, no makeup eyelashes. Match the same regular crisp square pixel grid as the surrounding hair. No blur, no smooth portrait shading, no color filter. Keep the bright warm skin and chestnut/teal/brown costume palette exactly in the same family. Do not change the hairstyle or hairline, head scale, outfit, body shape, any limb position, or create new motion. One full sprite only, transparent background, no ground, no words.
